notes: Adds `--once` to the shared option flag set and rejects it alongside `--vus`, `--duration`, `--iterations` or `--stage`. It rewrites the consolidated options before derive and validate, so the result reaches run, cloud run and archive. Each case is handled: no scenarios uses `default`, a single scenario keeps exec, env, tags and options, and multiple scenarios are an error. Unit, integration and archive tests are thorough. One minor gap: shortcut values coming from env vars or the config file are silently discarded rather than flagged.

The flag is defined in the shared option flag set, so it reaches run, cloud and archive. Shortcut-flag conflicts are rejected with a clear error. The transform runs after consolidation and before deriveAndValidateConfig, keeping exec, env, tags and options while switching to a 1/1 shared-iterations executor and clearing top-level shortcut options. Unit, integration and archive tests are thorough. Minor nit: conflicts are checked only for CLI flags, not for equivalent env vars, which are silently dropped.

The patch fixes the reported root-module case by returning a slice of all same-module import blocks, but it still silently drops every child-module import block for a resource once a parent block claims it, even for different instances (its own fixture asserts this for baz["b"]); combined with the changed return type, this likely explains the 2/3 hidden test failures.

Returning every import block from the same module as a slice fixes the reported single-module for_each/count case. However, the parent-override is still keyed on the whole ConfigResource, so a parent block for one instance silently drops child blocks for other instances (or other module instances). That is the same class of silent drop, and the candidate's own fixture locks it in; it likely explains the 1/3 hidden-test result.

Adds unexported `isOpenBrace`/`isCloseBrace` Token helpers that require the token to be unquoted, and applies them to every brace comparison in the dispenser and parser (NextArg, NextBlock, ArgErr, addresses, directives, doImport snippet detection, blockTokens, open/closeCurlyBrace); it also drops the now-redundant `wasQuoted` check, and tests cover arguments, nested blocks, backtick quotes, snippets and the unclosed-block error case.

Adds unexported isOpenBrace/isCloseBrace helpers on Token that check wasQuoted, and applies them consistently across the dispenser (NextArg, NextBlock, ArgErr) and parser (addresses, directives, directive, doImport, blockTokens, open/closeCurlyBrace). This also removes the old partial wasQuoted check, and the change is backed by thorough tests covering double-quoted, backtick, nested-block, snippet and unclosed-block cases.

Fixes the root cause by wrapping a parenthesised NumberLiteral in a Wrapped unary-ADD DurationExpr, which the existing printer and evaluator already handle. It also adds constantDurationValue so the zero-duration and division/modulo-by-zero checks still fire through the new wrapper (e.g. `foo[(0)]`, `4d/(0)`, `foo[-(5s)]`). Tests cover every issue case in printer, parser AST/error and promqltest evaluation; the only nit is that the wrapper's position range excludes the parens, which is consistent with existing DurationExpr behaviour.

Fixes the root cause by wrapping a parenthesised NumberLiteral in a Wrapped unary-ADD DurationExpr, so the parentheses print on round-trip. It also updates the positive-duration and div/mod-by-zero checks through a small constantDurationValue helper, so `foo[(0)]` and `4d/(0)` are still rejected at parse time. Tests cover printing, the updated ASTs, parse errors and engine evaluation; the minor nits are the doubly nested AST for `-(5)` and a position range that points at the literal rather than the parentheses.

Applies ancestor section slugs to the section base and to page container dirs through a new SectionBase descriptor field, with a guarded prefix replacement; it covers sections, nested sections, non-section subdirectories, leaf bundles, taxonomies and terms, and has a solid integration test, though it relies on string-prefix rewriting and does not address server-mode rebuild of descendants when a section slug changes.

The patch fixes the root cause by passing a slug-adjusted section base into the target-path descriptor, built by walking ancestors. Branch pages, descendant pages, nested non-section directories, taxonomies and terms all pick up ancestor slugs, and the hidden tests pass. The ancestor walk is recomputed for every page and uses string prefix surgery, and it is unclear whether server-mode rebuilds invalidate child paths when a parent's slug changes. The integration test is solid but skips permalink-config and disablePathToLower interplay.

A ReturnError sentinel, raised as a panic from evalCall and recovered in executeWithState and in an overridden walkTemplate, gives working early return in all templates and also handles try correctly; however, it still relies on an AST rewrite (moving return to the end of the pipeline) and static detection of returns with a value, which yields odd errors like 'can't give argument to non-function 1' and returns nil when no return is reached; it also rewrites an existing test's expected error, and with 2 hidden tests and the package suite failing, the behaviour diverges from what is expected.

Uses a ReturnError sentinel that is panicked in evalCall and recovered per template execution and per {{ template }} call, which makes early return work in any template, but 2 of 8 hidden tests and the package suite fail. Likely causes: it changes the public Executer/ExecuteWithContextAndKey signatures to (any, error), rewrites an existing test's expected error to fit the new behaviour, and keeps an AST rewrite (moveReturnLast) whose behaviour differs from what is expected, so {{ return 1 2 }} gives a confusing error.
